annotations.title: Renew an ad on the KillBounce Ads wall

description: Add days (1-30) to your ad on the KillBounce Ads wall. Pass the ad's id plus its x, y, w and h (from /ad-rent) so the price can be quoted; it's the same rate as renting that space. A live ad's end date moves out; an ad not yet approved gets more days once it is. Expired ads can't be renewed: rent the space again. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.
name: ad_renew
